description: This file defines the Currency model for the Opencart admin localization module. It includes methods for managing currency records in the database, such as adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving currencies.

classes.name: Currency
classes.description: Model class responsible for CRUD operations related to currency data in the database within the Opencart admin localization module.

methods.name: addCurrency
methods.description: Inserts a new currency record into the database and returns its primary key ID.

methods.name: editCurrency
methods.description: Updates an existing currency record identified by its ID.

methods.name: editValueByCode
methods.description: Updates the value of a currency identified by its code.

methods.name: deleteCurrency
methods.description: Deletes a currency record from the database by its ID.

methods.name: getCurrency
methods.description: Retrieves a currency record from the database by its ID.

methods.name: getCurrencyByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a currency record from the database by its code.

methods.name: getCurrencies
methods.description: Retrieves a list of currencies, optionally filtered, sorted, and limited.

methods.name: getTotalCurrencies
methods.description: Returns the total count of currency records in the database.
